item.title: Postiz: trying to automate YouTube, VK, and RuTube - and why only one out of three actually works
item.author: pavel@prohomelab.com (Stilicho2011)
item.description: I set up self-hosted Postiz and try to connect it to YouTube, VK, and RuTube - walking through the real steps, the required env variables, and known bugs. In the end, out of three platforms, only one works reliably, and I honestly explain why.
